data.narrative:
Slate Auto is a Series C transportation company led by CEO Miles Arnone alongside co-founders Will Barker and Jeff Wilke, the latter a former Amazon executive. The company has raised $1.4B to date. The transportation sector peer set includes 7 private companies (Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, ZeroAvia, and Harbinger among them) and no public comparables, limiting conventional peer benchmarking.

The valuation analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, the only applicable triangulation method given data constraints. Using total raised capital of $1.4B as a proxy for post-Series B value and applying a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical for Series C advancement yields an implied valuation of $2.4B. A peer-median approach was not feasible; while 7 transportation companies exist in the reference set, none satisfied same-stage or adjacent-stage filters with sufficient sample size (minimum 3 required), making sector-wide medians uninformative.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $2.0B to $2.7B, centered on $2.4B. Key uncertainties include the reliability of total raised capital as a valuation proxy in the absence of disclosed Series B terms, the representativeness of the 1.7x multiplier for this specific founder profile and capital intensity, and the lack of direct public market comparables in frontier transportation. Validation would benefit from industry-specific stage metrics or additional transaction data from the peer set.
